linkedin.text:
🚨 Your AI agent dies every time you close the terminal.

You lose context. You lose progress. You restart from scratch.

Every. Single. Time.

Prime Agent changes that. It's a self-improving RLM agent that treats your workflow like persistent variables and keeps running even when you disconnect.

✅ Spawns child agents with code—they talk directly without routing through you
✅ Runs a persistent Python REPL so context survives crashes and terminal closes
✅ Refines itself across sessions and learns reusable patterns from every run

Almost 6,000 developers trust it for long research tasks that take days to finish. ⭐

Search GitHub for 'PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent' and give your agent the memory it deserves.

What's the longest task you've tried running with an AI agent?
